\[

a_k = b_{k-1},\\[4pt]

c_k = 2\,b_{k-1},

\[

\[
b_{2m}=2\cdot3^{\,m-1},\qquad
b_{2m+1}=3^{\,m}\qquad(m\ge 1),
\]

and \(b_1=1\).

\[
T_k=2a_k+2b_k+c_k
       =2b_{k-1}+2b_k+2b_{k-1}
